<quote by="Announced by Borys Vardovich Straskovich, Boyar of the Iron Roads">I commission the Wyrding Tower, a volhov tower proposed in an appraisal by Graciana i Lopez i Guerra. The Vale of the Verdant Promise will bring prosperity to the ruins left by the Cold Sun and will fund this ministry
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[ministry]] in Livardz, Volodmartz
* Announcement by the [[Boyar of the Iron Roads]]
* More information can be found in the '''[[Sunrise_over_Livardz#The_Wyrding_Pond|Sunrise over Livardz]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Summer 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 12 wains of mithril
* 36 crowns in labour costs 
* Three months to construct

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Wyrding_Tower}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the Wyrding Tower has had the following effects:
* The title [[Volhov of the Wyrding Tower]] will be available to appoint by tally of the votes of Varushkan mine and forest owners for the first time at the Autumn Equinox 388YE
* The threat of the [[Sunrise_over_Livardz#The_Ashen_Wind|ashen wind]] has been removed
